rv.q: Rage and desperation consume the little classroom, commanding complete attention for the one-act show.

But while the production provokes thought much as an abstract art exhibit might, it is ultimately unable to achieve enough clarity to be compelling, despite formidable commitment from the cast, crew, and designers.

cn.t: Mixed reception for this classroom-set Assassins: one critic praises its unhinged energy, while another finds the concept strains the source material. Sondheim's dark wit survives, but the production's bold reimagining divides.
